## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) and [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] A behaviour change has a requirement, a detailed design and a mock.
- [ ] Each acceptance test was written first and seen to fail for the expected reason.
- [ ] The requirement, design, mock, tests and code agree.
- [ ] No `write` or `control` command can be sent without the person's approval for that call.
- [ ] Model output, device names and byte-derived strings are rendered as text, never as HTML.
- [ ] No request leaves the device; nothing is sent to a backend or analytics.
- [ ] Lint, format, unit tests and behaviour specs pass, with no real device, Bluetooth or model.
